name: PIONEER 10
missionStatus: Mission complete. Silent since 2003; leaving the solar system.

model.note: Simplified visual reconstruction built in-app. Not an official NASA model.

briefNotes.text: Pioneer 10 was the first spacecraft to cross the asteroid belt and fly past Jupiter. It carries the Pioneer Plaque. It did not land anywhere and was not destroyed.
briefNotes.origin: Team research brief (NASA-based); final check against NASA sources recommended
